newsitem.title: THAILAND: Land & Houses offers more shares to ML&H.
newsitem.headline: Land & Houses offers more shares to ML&H.

text.p: Thai property developer Land & Houses Plc said on Tuesday it would offer an additional eight million new shares to its Philippine affiliate Manuela Land & Houses (ML&H) Corp and planned a one-for-one rights issue.

Under the offer, the number of new shares set aside for ML&H through private placement was raised to 18 million, compared with 10 million planned in April, at 10 baht ($3.85) each, Land & Houses said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The company said its board decided on Monday to increase the share offer to ML&H to offset Land & Houses' sharp share price decline since April, in-line with an overall bearish market.
Land & Houses holds a 40 percent stake in ML&H and Philippine shopping mall owner Manuela Corp has the remaining 60 percent.
Land & Houses has also offered shareholders a 1-for-1 rights issue of 162.3 million shares at 10 baht each. The rights offer closes on June 2.
Shares in Land & Houses closed the Tuesday morning session at 43.50 baht.
